name: Setogiwa ni Haeta
source:
A pixel-art erotic animation of a futanari being squeezed/milked.

You can enjoy, through simple text and pixel-art animation, the scene of a woman who grows a penis at the critical moment and becomes a futanari, having her penis toyed with by two women in a world on the brink of death.
